steps.say: ORAL Surveillance is randomizing older rheumatoid patients to tofacitinib or TNF blockade. Age 50 or more with at least 1 cardiovascular risk factor is entering the trial. Tofacitinib is flunking non-inferiority with higher heart and cancer hazard ratios. Labels worldwide are rewritten after the failure. Failed non-inferiority is rewriting labels.

steps.say: RAVE is pitting rituximab against daily oral cyclophosphamide in severe vasculitis. Dosing at 375 mg per meter squared weekly for 4 doses is matching the alkylator. Remission induction at 6 months is ending in a draw. Relapsing disease at entry is breaking the tie for rituximab. B-cell depletion is equaling alkylators except in relapse.

steps.say: PEXIVAS is testing plasma exchange in 704 vasculitis patients at once. Severe renal impairment with alveolar hemorrhage is entering the largest trial. Routine exchange is failing to cut mortality or dialysis. Reduced steroids are matching full dose with fewer infections. Exchange is exiting while less steroid is sufficing.

steps.say: ADVOCATE is proving avacopan against a prednisone taper in vasculitis. Oral dosing at 30 mg twice daily is replacing the steroid taper. Non-inferiority at 26 weeks with superiority in sustained remission at 52 weeks is crowning the swap. Renal recovery with rising filtration and no steroid wreckage is following. Complement pills are beating steroid tapers.

steps.say: BLISS-LN is adding belimumab to lupus nephritis induction backbones. Intravenous dosing at 10 mg per kg is joining mycophenolate or Euro-Lupus cyclophosphamide. Renal response of 43 versus 32 percent at week 104 is separating the arms. Renal events with deaths are halved by the addition. Added BAFF blockade is doubling renal wins.

steps.say: SENSCIS is proving nintedanib in scleroderma lung disease. Oral dosing at 150 mg twice daily is braking lung capacity loss. Slowing by 44 percent versus placebo is winning approvals. Yearly FVC decline is bending toward flat. Kinase pills are braking lung decline nearly halfway.

steps.say: Gout safety is splitting between CARES alarm and FAST reassurance. Febuxostat with allopurinol is compared in both cardiovascular trials. Higher all-cause and cardiac death on febuxostat is reported by CARES. Non-inferiority for cardiac death, major events, and all-cause mortality in 6,128 patients is reported by FAST. Small alarm with big reassurance is closing the debate.
